node.title: Exact slope-resolved support-pair moment
node.statement: For exact (k+t)-supports S,T at exchange distance d, the joint top-coefficient interpolation map has rank t+min(d,t). Hence for each fixed slope z their exact joint contribution probability is alpha_d(1-2q^(-t)+alpha_d), alpha_d=q^(-t-min(d,t)); supports at distance d>=t are exactly independent. Summing gives the exact restricted-family fixed-slope factorial moment consumed by averaged_slope_conversion.
node.notes: REPAIRED CLOSURE 2026-07-27. The former auto-proof was invalid, but upstream commit 674503f contains a later elementary exact support-collinearity theorem. Locally rederived and verified on 9,047 interpolation-matrix support pairs plus exhaustive toy pair counts. Scope is the averaged fixed-slope moment only, not worst-case XR or cross-slope independence.
